seo_title: FSSAI Orders New Dairy Logo by July 2028
title: FSSAI Mandates New Standard Logo on Milk, Curd and Paneer Packs From July 2028
court: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
case_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Second Amendment Regulations, 2026
citation: Notified 6 November 2026; published in the Gazette of India on 9 November 2026
card_summary: FSSAI's Second Amendment to the 2020 Labelling and Display Regulations adds a standardised logo requirement to Schedule I for specified milk and milk products, including liquid milk, curd and paneer. The amendment was notified on 6 November 2026 and published in the Gazette on 9 November 2026. Compliance is due by 1 July 2028, giving manufacturers about twenty months to redesign packaging.
card_tip: Dairy manufacturers should start logo and artwork clearance well before 2028. Earlier FSSAI labelling amendments have shown packaging stock and printer lead times eat into the compliance window faster than expected.
verification_notes: The logo requirement, its placement in Schedule I, the covered product categories (milk, curd, paneer and related products) and the 1 July 2028 compliance date are reported consistently by SCC Online Blog, Business Today, Dairy Business MEA, Agro & Food Processing and TeamLease RegTech. Sources vary slightly on the exact notification date, giving 4, 6 or 9 November 2026; the majority report final notification on 6 November 2026 with Gazette publication on 9 November 2026, which is the version used here. The Gazette notification itself (egazette.gov.in) was located but not independently opened to confirm the text.
